notes.title: Playing With Fire Update 1
notes.notes:
Now you can make fire by lighting brandy with a gas torch. 
Also improved how the camera works,  it pans when the cursor is near the left and right edges of the screen

Exploding Bottles

notes.title: UPDATE: Damned Flies
notes.notes:
Annoying flies make the newly implemented customer patience timer go down fast.
Catch them using chopsticks Mr Miyagi style! 
Customer patience decreases while they wait to be fed and they will leave if their patience runs out
